notes.title: Soundtrack DLC
notes.notes:
Xenocide OST is now available!

The soundtrack contains 12 awesome tracks with total playtime of 51 minutes.

As a thank you for all you nice people who purchased the game, the soundtrack will be [u]completely free![/u] We are also releasing a patch that includes all the fixes made since release.

Once again, thank you for your support, it means a lot to us!
